title: Stopping at a place
cue: What to say on halting at a place on a journey
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatillaahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 2708: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/6812

usage.evidence: Whoever stops at a place and says this, nothing will harm him until he moves on from it (Muslim 2708).
